steps.js: (() => { const w = document.querySelector('.hwp-editor-host iframe')?.contentWindow const s = w?.rhwpStudio if (!s) return 'no-studio' if (!w.__e2eCaretHome) { s.automation.registerCommand({ id: 'ext:e2e-caret-home', label: 'E2E caret home', execute(services) { services.getInputHandler().moveCursorTo({ sectionIndex: 0, paragraphIndex: 0, charOffset: 0 }) } }) w.__e2eCaretHome = true } s.automation.execute('ext:e2e-caret-home') w.focus() w.document.querySelector('textarea')?.focus() return 'ok' })()

(async () => { const s = document.querySelector('.hwp-editor-host iframe')?.contentWindow?.rhwpStudio; if (!s) return null; await s.plugins.load('ieum-agent'); const r = await s.plugins.invoke('ieum-agent', 'findText', ['SEU-E2E-hwp']); return { count: r.count } })()
